hooks.name: total-recall Retrieve
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to search memory before answering questions or starting tasks

action.prompt: Before answering the user's message: if it is a question, task, or involves project context — call `memory_search` with the user's message as the query (warm tier). Use the results to inform your answer. Do NOT search for pure greetings, one-word replies, or messages that are only asking you to run a command. Say nothing to the user about this check.
